title: Make saved Clippy findings discoverable after a passing run
outcome: Make saved Clippy findings discoverable after a passing run
acceptance: A passing run with Clippy warnings directs the recipient to the warning count and saved located findings, using bounded numeric completion metadata or clear guidance to results.json stages[].advisories.clippy.
Preserve the two leading completion lines, the machine-record contract, native exits and stage verdicts; warning discovery itself must not turn a warning-only pass into a failure.
